note: Search vocabulary for finding catalogue cars from what people type: Hebrew model names, English manufacturer names and spelling variants, each mapped to words of the catalogue cars' CSV manufacturer, CSV commercial name or drive (rules.json valueOfUse.driveField). Not business data. Every target must exist in the catalogue; this is checked when the search index is built. Keys and targets are normalized the same way as user input (case, hyphens, apostrophes, final letters).
